reason: No regulator is asking me for agent controls yet, and every dollar I spend on tooling is a dollar I'm not spending on an engineer. If we do open accounts to agents to keep up with the competitor, I'd start with our own caps and a kill switch, maybe poke at the free tier, but I'm not signing an LOI or a contract.
objection: It's a pre-revenue startup with no customers and no SOC 2 asking to sit in the path of every trade and payment on my venue. That's a single point of failure and a vendor risk I'd have to defend, for a problem nobody is forcing me to solve yet.
would_change_my_mind: A regulator or a major banking or custody partner telling us agent activity needs this kind of identity check and audit trail, plus a finished SOC 2 or an open-source core I can self-host.
